meta.name: localize
meta.description: 运行本地化工作流：提取字符串、验证本地化就绪状态、检查硬编码文本，并生成可供翻译的字符串表。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提取并管理代码中的待翻译字符串
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在代码中提取文本并生成翻译表
copy.tagline_en: Extract and manage translatable strings from code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to extract text from code and generate translation tables

howto.what: Claude 可以扫描代码中的硬编码字符串、提取新字符串并生成或更新字符串表、验证翻译完整性和格式，以及报告整体本地化状态。
howto.when: 当用户要求进行本地化检查、提取字符串、验证翻译或查看状态时，例如说出“扫描硬编码文本”或“提取字符串”。

say.text: 扫描项目中的硬编码文本
say.note: Claude 会搜索未使用本地化函数的字符串

say.text: 提取新字符串并生成字符串表
say.note: Claude 会比较现有表并生成差异

say.text: 验证当前翻译的完整性
say.note: Claude 会检查缺失翻译和占位符匹配

howto.what_en: Claude can scan code for hardcoded strings, extract new strings and generate/update string tables, validate translation completeness and formatting, and report localization status.
howto.when_en: When the user asks to perform localization tasks such as scanning hardcoded text, extracting strings, validating translations, or checking status.

say_en.text: Scan the project for hardcoded text
say_en.note: Claude will search for strings not wrapped in localization functions

say_en.text: Extract new strings and generate string table
say_en.note: Claude compares with existing tables and outputs diff
Claude checks missing translations and placeholder mismatches
